asset.description: The mark shows a minimalist orange rounded square containing a cream negative-space coffee cup beside the dark green wordmark "KOLA" and the subtext "COFFEE · LAGOS". Its clean, flat design is intended for a light background.

turns.prompt: Build a landing page for Kola Coffee, a coffee kiosk in Yaba, Lagos, that opens at 7am and sells cold brew and zobo. Use my logo and brand colours.
turns.context: context: 22 of 22 files in full (App.tsx, index.html, index.ts, package.json, index.ts, chain.ts, ConnectButton.tsx, badge.tsx, button.tsx, card.tsx, input.tsx, label.tsx, notice.tsx, skeleton.tsx, textarea.tsx, format.ts, hooks.ts, tokens.ts, useWallet.ts, utils.ts, main.tsx, styles.css)
turns.reply: Your Kola Coffee landing page is built: a hero with your logo on the green brand colour, opening hours and a "doors open 7:00 AM" stat, a filterable menu of cold brew and zobo, a three-step "how the morning works" section, a Yaba location card with hours, and a closing call to action — all in your logo's orange and dark green with Fraunces headings. I picked Fraunces as the display font and used your logo as the favicon. Two things to know: the menu prices (₦1,000–₦1,500) and the exact street address are placeholders I marked on the page, so send me the real ones and I'll swap them in.
